traits.d: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.d: The knight makes two melee attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.n: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.d: For 1 minute, the knight can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 ft. of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the knight. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the knight is incapacitated.

reactions.d: The knight adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the knight must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

tips: Слабый спасбросок: Ловкость / Интеллект / Мудрость (+0) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
Мультиатака — наносит несколько ударов за ход. Эффекты обездвиживания/оглушения особенно ценны против него.
